1f62f4468e41.english: Wet-lab measurement on isogenic human neural lines; not executable from this module. Possible in silico first: recompute the neuron-library scale and the EGR1 observation (IPOTESI) on the deposits. Reopen if a WWOX-deficient neural BNIP3 protein or flux datum is published. Priority: below the ten-row line; it gates three proposals, not the module.

330c78175c31.english: Known in the WWOX system: the organoid transcript observation; the premise question is restated from the IT41 package B.

4619c9114dc4.english: WWOX-system: organoid transcript +0.46 log2, not robust; the raw neuron-library sign is a scale artefact; no protein or flux. Non-WWOX neural: protein up in hypoxia with glucose and down in oxygen-glucose deprivation in HT22, with BNIP3 loss harmful in the deprivation arm; rat epilepsy HIF-inhibitor test lowered HIF-1alpha and raised BNIP3 (hif1a_bnip3_it41_20261109, partial full texts, one embargoed).

62055735b086.english: Three generated proposals (IT21P2-0001 to 0003) carry a HIF1A-to-BNIP3 chain; until now they showed no premise of their own and would have read as the HIF1A-to-HK2 premise. The package finds the transcript signal small and partly an artefact, no protein or flux measurement, and a context-dependent direction: the correct output today is an abstention with this question.

b7bcebea37ce.english: Premise measurement: transcript only; protein and role not measured. (no ranked unit, so no evaluation depth applies: this is not a depth of zero)

bccb9591cef8.english: Queried on 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-10 in the package hif1a_bnip3_it41_20261109 (search of this module and open sources, not a statement about the literature).

bfd77a0d95dc.english: Whether BNIP3 is raised at protein level in WWOX-deficient neural cells, whether the rise is HIF-driven, HIF-independent or a culture-state artefact, and whether the function is protective or harmful there; until then no pharmacological direction at BNIP3 is sustainable and no compound is proposed.

c668d9eb574e.english: In isogenic WWOX-deficient against add-back human neural cells at matched oxygen: does BNIP3 protein rise, does it fall on HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown, and does BNIP3 knockdown make survival, ROS and membrane potential better or worse?

cc42c8caccec.english: Step 1, no compound: BNIP3 and BNIP3L protein and mRNA from the same lysates, WWOX-deficient against add-back human neural cells at 21, 5 and 1 percent oxygen; step 2: HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown with HIF target readouts; step 3: BNIP3 knockdown with survival, ROS and membrane potential. The full list of measurements is in the package table of the HIF1A-to-BNIP3 delivery.
